resources.string:
At E-Alert, we are committed to making a difference by providing a quick and reliable way for people to report emergencies and urgent situations.

Through our website and mobile application, individuals can easily seek help, ensuring that the right response reaches them as fast as possible.

As we work towards this mission, we hold on to the promise of Psalms 46:1:
"God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble."

At E-Alert, we believe that every second counts—because help should always be within reach.

NDRRMC \n National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council serves as the President\'s adviser on disaster preparedness programs, disaster operations and rehabilitation efforts undertaken by the government and the private sector.
BFP \n The BFP (Bureau of Fire Protection) is the agency responsible for fire prevention, suppression, and emergency response in the Philippines.
PRC \n The PRC (Philippine Red Cross) is a humanitarian organization that provides emergency response, disaster relief, health services, and blood donation programs in the Philippines.

PNP \n The PNP (Philippine National Police) is the national police force of the Philippines. It is responsible for enforcing the law, maintaining peace and order, and ensuring public safety across the country.
